name: Kitamoto (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kitamoto city emblem in blue: a broken ring of concentric arcs with small strokes at the top and bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Kitamoto, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1965.

features.role: Kitamoto city emblem — a broken ring of concentric arcs with small strokes at the top and bottom
